pages.text: $(#8B0000)🌋 Molten Core Armor · Infernal Elixir 🔥$()$(br2)$(l)$(#FF4500)「Let magma surge through your veins, turning damage into a mere caress of the furnace」$()$(br)The scorching power of $(#8B0000)Magma Cream$(), the toxicity of $(#4B0082)Nether Wart$(), the blood-circulating energy of $(#FF0000)Dried Safflower$(), and the spiciness of $(#D2691E)Dried Ginger$() fuse upon the $(#CD5C5C)Demonic Cutting Board$()—creating a pact-bound infernal drink capable of $(l)temporarily transforming flesh into a lava-born entity$().

$(#8B0000)▌ Dual Infernal Effects $()$(br2)$(l)$(#FF4500)🛡 Eternal Magma Armor$()$(br)Skin crystallizes into $(#CD5C5C)obsidian patterns$(), insulating against extreme heat.$(br2)$(l)$(#FF69B4)💥 Lava Pulse$()$(br)Upon drinking, $(#FF1493)scarlet healing waves$() explode outward.

$(br2)$(#4B0082)▌ Demonic Crafting $()$(br)- Use a $(#696969)Nether Rock Mortar$() to crush $(#8B0000)Magma Cream$() into $(#CD5C5C)Liquid Fire Seeds$().$(br)- Roast $(#4B0082)Nether Wart$() and $(#D2691E)Ginger Slices$() over $(#FF4500)Sulfur Flames$() until they reach $(#8B0000)caramelization$().$(br)- Stir in $(#FF0000)Safflower$() using a $(#FFD700)reverse-cross$() motion.$(br2)$(#FF0000)⚠️$() Once the liquid forms $(#8B0000)lava layers$() and emits $(#FF4500)sulfuric steam$(), immediately seal the container.

$(br2)$(#8B0000)『 Infernal Behemoth Codex 』$()$(br)Engraved upon a magma beast’s shell:$(br)'Those who drink this $(#CD5C5C)contracted blood$(),$(br)shall receive the $(#FF4500)blessing of the Infernal Lord$()—$(br)For $(#8B0000)three lunar cycles$(), they shall withstand $(#FF0000)hellfire$(),$(br)and enjoy the $(#FF69B4)brief pulse of rebirth$().$(br)However, consuming it under a $(#4B0082)Blood Moon$()$(br)will turn the $(#696969)obsidian markings$() into $(#000000)a permanent curse$().'
